baseline: 09-D C3_SF CONDITIONAL, unmodified current PlanA adapter
final_access: only after development geometry and motion gates pass and encoder/probe selections freeze

memory.fusion: 09-C measured surfel weighted position/normal fusion; current F5 from last measurement
memory.acceptance: PlanA C3 Box input, main only; memory rejects isolated/undersupported components, then connected-to-map support; same B1/B2 rules
memory.B1: world frame identity origin, diagnostic registration only, never transport nodes
memory.B2: 09-C estimated registration; apply accepted rigid pose only
memory.unobservable: retain prior geometry with increasing uncertainty; no hidden-motion claim
memory.B_SAFE: not registered; do not tune on final

features.reason: match PlanA zero temporal extras; status/confidence retained in sidecar; historical variation/jump unavailable

gate.aggregation: episode macro; all native/cap128/matched_N; validation primary; no post-final threshold edits
gate.missing_required_stratum: CONDITIONAL only if all supported safety metrics pass; any contamination/accuracy safety failure => NO-GO

motion.hidden_control: live moved RGB-D, paired observation blackout; sensor ablation, not a physical occluder
motion.partial_control: fixed raster half-mask observation ablation; not a physical occluder
